hypothesis: Publish real native GPU contact/counter/profile/occupancy diagnostics with correct shared combined routing; separate public contact records from scheduling snapshots and allocated buffers.
scope: Diagnostic host/API plus persistent contact-peak output; no solver policy/physics changes, no Rain or headline timing.
contract: b3Counters body/shape/joint counts are live public topology; contactCount is synchronized native contact-registry entries, excludes sensors/private proxies.
GPU component count uses completed body island labels and reports unavailable after topology mutation; published availability/freshness distinguishes current topology and completed solver state.

Public counters are explicit potentially blocking diagnostics. Existing per-frame metadata/sidebar/benchmark accounting uses cheap topology and existing scheduling metrics, avoiding implicit full contact downloads.
b3Profile maps only measured GPU stages, milliseconds, with timestamp step. Unmeasured CPU/substage fields are NaN with a published availability mask, never fabricated zero.

b3World_GetMaxCapacity reports peak live public body/shape-proxy occupancy at positive step boundaries, and supported non-sensor contact roots during pre-CCD occupied-list collection, not reserved buffer capacity. Contact peak persists across unobserved steps, retirement and capacity growth using query word 74 plus host carry.
Memory output reports actual owned primary GPU buffer byte sizes in 64bits, explicitly excludes shared pipeline/driver/renderer memory.
Bounds dump outputs actual public shape AABBs and ownership. Invalid/stale/locked worlds report explicit invalid/busy status; querying diagnostics never clears sticky world failure.
Combined public functions report GPU values; explicit CPU stats helper still reports correctly mapped CPU values.
New future-observable diagnostic peaks are captured/validated with old schema compatibility; no physics tolerance relaxations.
Compatibility profile fields are documented GPU aggregate aliases, not measurements of distinct CPU substages. GPU viewer diagnostics label each measured aggregate and unavailable CPU-only fields.
Extended diagnostics use status 0 invalid/stale argument, 1 valid, 2 busy/reentrant, 3 sticky physics failure. Compatibility wrappers publish EINVAL/EBUSY/EIO with the thread-local operation name.

budget.storage_comparator_controls: existing suite once; corruption controls for diagnostic peaks

stop_rule: Retain every trial and build failure. Stop a campaign on first assertion failure. Diagnose exact cause and record any harness/protocol corrections before remaining budget; never replace failed completed trials or selectively extend it. Final PR02 remains open until all requirements are verified.
recordings: Build/correctness/required CPU-first precommit captures are separate from run budget; record affected scenes before committing shader/visual changes.
next_before_runs: Implement fixture/selectors, record exact commands/settings, compile before/after input receipts and frozen hashes, then run serially on actual NVIDIA Vulkan.
